question.worked_solution:
To use integration by parts, let's suppose that 

$$
\begin{aligned}u={e}^{4x}\, & ⇒\,\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=4{e}^{4x}\,, \\ \frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}=\operatorname{cos}⁡x\, & ⇒\,v=\int \operatorname{cos}⁡x\,\text{d}x=\operatorname{sin}⁡x.\end{aligned}
$$

Then, using the formula of integration by parts, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}I & =\int {e}^{4x}\operatorname{cos}⁡x\,\text{d}x \\  & =\int u\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x \\  & =uv-\int v\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={e}^{4x}\operatorname{sin}⁡x-\int (\operatorname{sin}⁡x)(4{e}^{4x})\text{d}x \\  & ={e}^{4x}\operatorname{sin}⁡x-4\int {e}^{4x}\operatorname{sin}⁡x\,\text{d}x \\  & ={e}^{4x}\operatorname{sin}⁡x-4J.\end{aligned}
$$

Again, we can use integration by parts to evaluate

$$
J=\int {e}^{4x}\operatorname{sin}⁡x\,\text{d}x.
$$

To do this, let's suppose that

$$
\begin{aligned}u={e}^{4x}\, & ⇒\,\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=4{e}^{4x}\,, \\ \frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}=\operatorname{sin}⁡x\, & ⇒\,v=\int \operatorname{sin}⁡x\,\text{d}x=-\operatorname{cos}⁡x.\end{aligned}
$$

Using the formula of integration by parts, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}J & =\int {e}^{4x}\operatorname{sin}⁡x\,\text{d}x \\  & =\int u\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x \\  & =uv-\int v\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={e}^{4x}(-\operatorname{cos}⁡x)-\int (-\operatorname{cos}⁡x)(4{e}^{4x})\text{d}x \\  & =-{e}^{4x}\operatorname{cos}⁡x+4\int {e}^{4x}\operatorname{cos}⁡x\,\text{d}x \\  & =-{e}^{4x}\operatorname{cos}⁡x+4I.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, substituting this back into our equation for $I,$ we can subsequently solve for $I.$ We remember to add a constant of integration $C$ at the end.

$$
\begin{aligned}I & ={e}^{4x}\operatorname{sin}⁡x-4J \\ I & ={e}^{4x}\operatorname{sin}⁡x-4(-{e}^{4x}\operatorname{cos}⁡x+4I) \\ I & ={e}^{4x}\operatorname{sin}⁡x+4{e}^{4x}\operatorname{cos}⁡x-16I \\ 17I & ={e}^{4x}\operatorname{sin}⁡x+4{e}^{4x}\operatorname{cos}⁡x \\ I & =\frac{{e}^{4x}(\operatorname{sin}⁡x+4\operatorname{cos}⁡x)}{17}+C\end{aligned}
$$
